scope: Atomic installation, piping and individual commissioning of one explicitly selected 500 kW natural-gas hot-water boiler with a separately selected modulating burner. Civil works, common flues, building ventilation, fire systems, building automation and the complete boiler house are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved heating project organization, selected boiler and burner manufacturers and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved boiler and burner schedule with exact product designations and passports
approved piping, valve, safety-group and instrumentation schedules
flue-adapter detail with confirmed high-temperature sealant quantity
method statement with installation and piping labor, lifting, welding and torque-tool quantities
hydraulic and protection test program with test pump, flue-gas analyzer and commissioning labor
conditional gas-train, circulation-pump, heat-exchanger, expansion-vessel and water-treatment schedules
supplier pack sizes and approved retained-spare quantities for the boiler and burner
forbiddenClaims: automatic boiler, burner, gas-train or hydraulic design
universal piping, valve, safety, instrumentation, sealant or auxiliary-equipment consumption
universal labor, lifting, welding, testing or logistics productivity
civil works, common flues, building systems or complete boiler house included
